sources.snippet: Introduction Hi, I'm miruky. TypeSafe AI introduced Jev in early access on September 15, 2026. Its product page puts Zero Hallucinations beside striking latency and cost numbers. When I saw that phrase, I went looking for the missing boundary: what does a hallucination mean when the model cannot generate arbitrary text in the first place?
